newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-WALKER VOWS TO KEEP SPENDING.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WALKER VOWS TO KEEP SPENDING.

text.p: Jack Walker, who has poured more than 50 million pounds ($80 million) into Blackburn Rovers, promises to keep on spending.

Blackburn's benefactor hopes to persuade a big-name manager to lift the club off the bottom of the English premier league, and will offer the bait of money to be available to strengthen the playing staff.
"My position hasn't changed," tax-exile Walker said from his Jersey home on Monday. "My commitment to the club remains as firm as ever. I will continue to back them."
Walker was in England on Sunday to see Blackburn beat Liverpool 3-0 at home.
"We were certainly overdue that," he added, after the champions of two seasons ago finally secured a victory in their 12th league match.
Walker has drawn up a short list of candidates to fill the post vacated by Ray Harford last month.
His number one target is likely to be former England coach Terry Venables.
Walker has also considered another manager with an international background, ex-Ireland boss Jack Charlton.
But Charlton has promotional commitments until well into the New Year and has said he will not decide whether to re-enter management until the end of the season.
